fusions.name: Bolting Peck
fusions.desc: Bolts at the target and deals 14 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. You rush to the target first, and your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Startle Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts out in every direction, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Flushed Dash
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 30% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Ground Covered
fusions.desc: When you cover a stretch of ground, you deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
